! IOS-XE コンフィグ（逸脱あり: IP ミスマッチ・不足インターフェース・BGP ASN 誤り）
!
version 17.6
hostname Router01
!
interface Loopback0
 ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.255
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description To ISP
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description To Upstream
 ip address 10.1.0.99 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
router bgp 65000
 bgp router-id 10.0.0.1
 neighbor 10.1.0.2 remote-as 65099
 neighbor 10.1.0.2 description To fw-01
!
end
